caveMansion.title: Mansion above a vast cave
caveMansion.description: A woodland mansion stands over a deep open cavern near spawn, with a pale garden and another mansion nearby.

dualMountainBowls.title: Twin mountain bowls
dualMountainBowls.description: Two neighboring mountain bowls offer dramatic base sites, with a village, ocean and badlands nearby.

villageSinkhole.title: Village inside a sinkhole
villageSinkhole.description: A village descends into a huge cave, with a ruined portal, cherry trees and mountains nearby.

structuresEverywhere.title: Mansion and village at spawn
structuresEverywhere.description: A woodland mansion, village and several other structures make the starting area dense with places to explore.

cherryBlossomIsland.title: Cherry grove island
cherryBlossomIsland.description: A cherry-covered landscape offers a village, a deep cave, an outpost and a ruined portal nearby.

outpostSpire.title: Outpost on a stone spire
outpostSpire.description: A pillager outpost crowns a narrow coastal spire, creating a striking challenge and lookout.

mansionOutpostVillage.title: Mansion, village and outpost
mansionOutpostVillage.description: A mansion, village, outpost and desert temple sit close together, with caves and more structures below.

beachSulfurCave.title: Sulfur cave by the beach
beachSulfurCave.description: A sulfur cave meets the coast near a desert village, combining new cave terrain with an easy surface route.

icyLakeVillage.title: Villages around an icy lake
icyLakeVillage.description: Two snowy villages face a broad frozen lake, with caves and room for a winter base.

desertLandmarks.title: Four desert landmarks
desertLandmarks.description: A desert village, temple, pillager outpost and shipwreck cluster near spawn beside a mangrove swamp.

farmsGalore.title: Village full of farms
farmsGalore.description: A large farming village has plentiful fields, animals and food for a relaxed survival start.

blacksmithCherry.title: Blacksmith villages by a cherry grove
blacksmithCherry.description: Two villages with blacksmiths flank a cherry grove, with three trial chambers underneath.

fiveBlacksmith.title: Five blacksmiths in an autumn forest
fiveBlacksmith.description: A dappled forest start with a nearby five-blacksmith village and many exploration routes.

dappledVillages.title: Dappled forest and four villages
dappledVillages.description: The new forest begins beside spawn; four villages make this an inviting survival start.

burningMansion.title: Mansion on a fiery mountain
burningMansion.description: A woodland mansion sits against snowy peaks, with lava inside the structure and ancient cities below.

paleMansion.title: Mansion in a vast pale forest
paleMansion.description: A broad pale forest, nearby mansion and mountain scenery create a striking Bedrock start.

sulfurVillage.title: Sulfur spring beside a village
sulfurVillage.description: A surface sulfur spring points to the cave below, with a plains village close to spawn.

dappledIce.title: Autumn forest meets ice spikes
dappledIce.description: An abandoned camp and ruined portal near spawn lead toward ice spikes, cherry trees and an ancient city.

desertMansion.title: Tall mansion above the desert
desertMansion.description: An unusually elevated woodland mansion turns the spawn into a dramatic survival challenge.

sixVillages.title: Six villages across the plains
sixVillages.description: A broad village network, an outpost and a ruined portal give this world a strong start.

darkForestCamp.title: Dark forest mansion and camp
darkForestCamp.description: Start near a mansion, gather supplies from villages and a camp, then seek the autumn forest.

frozenMushroom.title: Mushroom island in a frozen sea
frozenMushroom.description: A mushroom island sits within reach of spawn, with two villages for early supplies.

ancientCities.title: Ancient cities under the mountains
ancientCities.description: Mountain scenery, four villages and a remarkable concentration of ancient cities underground.

paleGardenCamp.title: Pale garden and autumn campsite
paleGardenCamp.description: A pale garden borders an abandoned camp, with villages and autumn forest beyond.

tripleDappled.title: Three autumn forests by the sea
tripleDappled.description: Cross the water to a vast dappled forest, with a trial chamber and ancient city underneath.

desertWoodland.title: Woodland mansion in the desert
desertWoodland.description: A mansion rises from desert sand, with more rare structures across the region.

giantSulfur.title: Giant sulfur cave
giantSulfur.description: Four sulfur springs mark a vast cave, with a snowy village nearby for supplies.

jungleRuins.title: Four jungle temples
jungleRuins.description: A bamboo jungle holds four temples and trail ruins for an archaeology-rich start.

toweringCherry.title: Cherry grove above an outpost
toweringCherry.description: A tall cherry-covered hill rises over a plains outpost, with a trial chamber below.

lakesideTaiga.title: Taiga village by the lake
lakesideTaiga.description: A lakeside village hides trail ruins, while a shipwreck and trial chamber wait nearby.

islandCave.title: Sunflower island cave
islandCave.description: A small island opens into a deep cave and mineshaft for a compact survival start.

coralVillage.title: Desert village by a coral reef
coralVillage.description: Spawn beside a desert village overlooking coral reefs, shipwrecks and ocean ruins.

paleMountainVillage.title: Village beside a pale garden and mansion
paleMountainVillage.description: A mountain village borders a pale garden and woodland mansion, with an ancient city beneath.

desertSulfurVillage.title: Desert village above a sulfur cave
desertSulfurVillage.description: A desert village overlooks a ravine with a sulfur cave and a buried desert temple.

floatingSavanna.title: Savanna village floating at sea
floatingSavanna.description: A village sits in the ocean off the savanna coast, with ruins and another village nearby.

paleMountainValley.title: Pale garden between mountains
paleMountainValley.description: A vast pale garden fills the mountain valley, with six ancient cities hidden below.

sulfurMineshafts.title: Mineshafts in lush and sulfur caves
sulfurMineshafts.description: Three mineshafts thread through lush and sulfur caves close to spawn.

mangroveIsland.title: Mangrove swamp island
mangroveIsland.description: Mangroves, plains and savanna share an island ringed by shipwrecks and ocean ruins.

taigaTrailRuins.title: Three trail ruins in the taiga
taigaTrailRuins.description: Explore three trail ruins and two taiga villages, including one above an iron-rich ravine.

coldOceanShipwreck.title: Shipwreck inside cold ocean ruins
coldOceanShipwreck.description: A shipwreck has crashed into cold ocean ruins beneath a frozen sea.

dappledCanopy.title: Windswept autumn island
dappledCanopy.description: An island crowned by dappled forest rises above caves, waterfalls and amethyst geodes.

quadTaigaVillages.title: Four villages near a snowy taiga
quadTaigaVillages.description: Four villages cluster near spawn, with a mineshaft and cold ocean ruins to explore.

dualSnowyVillages.title: Two snowy villages at spawn
dualSnowyVillages.description: Two large snowy villages share the starting area, with a ruined portal and frozen ruins nearby.

dappledRiverIsland.title: Autumn forest around a river island
dappledRiverIsland.description: A river wraps a plains island with two villages; a nearby dappled forest hides abandoned camps.

glacialAutumn.title: Autumn island below jagged peaks
glacialAutumn.description: A stony shore leads to a mountain dappled forest, shipwreck and ancient city below.

scatteredSeasons.title: Four seasons in one view
scatteredSeasons.description: Autumn poplars, cherry blossoms, ice spikes and green plains meet around spawn.

dappledRange.title: Autumn forest beneath snowy slopes
dappledRange.description: Dappled forest meets cherry groves and snowy slopes, with a small village valley beyond.

cherryLakeVillage.title: Village beside a cherry valley lake
cherryLakeVillage.description: A quiet lake rests below cherry-covered peaks, with villages near its shores.

cherryGroveVillage.title: Cliffside cherry grove and lake village
cherryGroveVillage.description: A peaceful valley climbs into a vast cherry grove; a village overlooks the lake beyond.

mesaCrater.title: Mesa crater on the forest edge
mesaCrater.description: A huge badlands crater opens where terracotta meets a green forest.

threeBiomeVillage.title: Village where three biomes meet
threeBiomeVillage.description: A village sits between pink cherry groves, orange autumn woods and snowy ice spikes.

perfectMountain.title: Towering mountain island
perfectMountain.description: A steep stone peak rises above the ocean, with caves and a village in the surrounding world.

mountainBowl.title: Cherry grove inside a mountain bowl
mountainBowl.description: A broad grassy valley and pink cherry trees sit inside a ring of snowy peaks.

waterSinkhole.title: Water sinkhole beneath the lake
waterSinkhole.description: A deep water-filled chasm drops through a mountain lake, with ice spikes nearby.

coralReefDesert.title: Coral reef in the desert
coralReefDesert.description: A bright reef forms an oasis where desert sands meet orange badlands.
